string-array.item: Beta access removed for all users on update (including owner)
Preset Lab unlock in Shop (~50k pts) — save and apply full timer setups
Daily economy: prices change each day within safe floors and ceilings
Sell titles, themes, hubs, and unlocks from Shop → Owned at today\'s price
Owned tab shows all purchases, not just themes
New Exams page — countdown, targets, study linked to timer
Recurring tasks — every day or pick dates; mark each day done
Number fields: backspace and retype while editing
Android: smoother return from other apps for ~30 minutes (no full refresh)
